title: Checking for IP Addresses on the Denylist

blocks.text: You can check if the Zscaler service is placing service access from an IP address on the denylist, due to suspicious traffic activity.
To check if the Zscaler service is placing an IP address on the denylist:

blocks.item: From the navigation menu, go to Internet Access > Tools > Denylist IP Check.
Enter the IP address you want to check, and click Check Denylist.

blocks.text: The Zscaler service displays the results. If the Zscaler service placed the IP address on the denylist, it displays the IP address with additional comments. If it didn't place the IP address on the denylist, then there are no results.
